messages:
Sam (docs): Hey team — PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 updates the migration guide and adds a new Python SDK snippet. Need reviewers and merge owner for today.

Ravi - SDK: I can review the Python snippet this afternoon. Quick question: are we stabilizing on client.stream_responses() in examples?

Mei - Eng: Yes, use client.stream_responses(). Also check the migration wording for 'dedicated pools' vs 'dedicated capacity'. Product copy prefers 'dedicated pools'.

Sam (docs): Good call. CI preview is failing on one anchor though — ci-bot says unresolved anchor /guides/migrate.html#old-flag

ci-bot: Preview failed: 1 link error at /guides/migrate.html#old-flag.

jenna: I renamed that header last week; the new anchor is #upgrading-flags. I'll push a tiny commit to the PR.

Ravi - SDK: I'll update the snippet to client.stream_responses() and run black.

Sam (docs): Can someone own merge during today's 15:30-16:30 PT window? Rotation is light.

jenna: I can merge at ~15:45 PT if CI is green. Also +1 to adding a simple OWNERS file in /docs/migrate to avoid repeated pings.

Mei - Eng: LGTM from eng after the API rename and wording change.

ci-bot: New preview build passed. Deployed preview: https://deploy-preview-501--docs.redwood.com

jenna: Merged at 15:47 PT. Follow-up: jenna opened issue to add OWNERS for migration folder.

Sam (docs): Thanks everyone :tada:

Ravi - SDK: Thanks — will scan other snippets for stream_responses() consistency.
